about_the_game:
Game Overview

This is a turn-based squad strategy/tactics game that cleverly combines classic Minesweeper mechanics with RPG elements. In the game, you must collect Arcane Cores, which generate energy vortexes around them. The strength of these vortexes hints at the number of nearby cores. By mastering this rule, you can safely absorb the Arcane Core's energy. However, stepping directly on an Arcane Core will trigger a devastating explosion.

You can recruit adventurers with unique skills and attributes. As characters progress, they can continuously draw random skills from a diverse pool. By adapting to the evolving battlefield and cleverly combining drawn skills, you'll discover an abundance of build possibilities and tactical combinations. Ultimately, the game challenges you to achieve the seemingly impossible: clearing the entire field in a single turn.

Game Features

Innovative Fusion of Gameplay — Embark on a Fantastical Adventure

Classic Minesweeper mechanics are seamlessly blended with RPG progression. Lead a team of adventurers, each with their own powerful abilities, to collect Arcane Cores by applying Minesweeper's core logic. Strengthen your squad, unlock potent talents, and tread carefully — one wrong move and you'll be brought to a halt.

Random Skill Combinations — Explore Deep Strategic Variety

When characters level up, they can choose from a pool of random skills to build unique combinations. You'll need to consider the current game state and team composition to select the most fitting skills. Every expedition offers new opportunities to craft diverse character builds and tactical strategies.

Ultimate Strategy — Challenge the One-Turn Clear

Every command matters. Each skill activation must be perfectly timed. Precision and foresight are key as you orchestrate intricate chains of actions and abilities to forge an unstoppable strategy. Your ultimate goal: clearing the entire board in a single turn — a feat as challenging as it is rewarding.

Start Your Adventure Now

Assemble your squad of adventurers and seek the legendary magical treasures! Face the challenge and forge your own magical legacy. Dive in and embark on your fantastical journey today!
